source: Acidvoice single-note samples (test/resources/303_saw-*.wav, 13 notes, a second TB-303)
reference_set: test/resources/303_saw-*.wav (13 notes, saw, knobs at min/half/max, A1-D3)
notes: The x0x.json model (sweep-tracked fit) with the constants that plausibly differ between units refitted to the 13 Acidvoice samples: cutoff law, accent sweep and VCA depth, resonance feedback and limit, Env Mod scale and offset, VEG decay, VCA resonance tap, post-HP and oscillator coupling. Pot laws, D24, square shape and timing stay at the x0x values (13 saw notes at min/half/max cannot constrain them). Weighted error on the 13 samples 1.97 (old-model acidvoice fit 2.42, x0x unchanged 7.11). Main difference to x0x: the cutoff range sits higher (220 Hz at knob minimum, 3.2 octaves span vs 184 Hz / 3.1 oct).
